$comment: Phase 2 media roles/labels, keyed by stable id. `expectFile` guards against id drift: scripts/build-media.test.mjs fails if a re-scan moves an id to a different source file. `crop` (pixels of the source) trims the source image: 2026-10-18 it cuts the transparent frame around the case-study phone mockups; it can also remove private/contact details. Nothing here ships except title/alt/role.
